#!/bin/sh
# gamedash-managed Rust server — generated by provision().
# World and player data: <ROOT>/installs/rust/server/gd_test
. <ROOT>/secrets.conf
cd "<ROOT>/installs/rust" || exit 1
export LD_LIBRARY_PATH="$LD_LIBRARY_PATH:<ROOT>/installs/rust/RustDedicated_Data/Plugins/x86_64"
exec ./RustDedicated -batchmode -nographics -logfile "<ROOT>/installs/rust/server/gd_test/server.log" \
    +server.identity "gd_test" \
    +server.port 28015 +server.queryport 28017 \
    +rcon.ip 127.0.0.1 +rcon.port 28016 +rcon.password "$GAME_ADMIN_PASSWORD" +rcon.web 1 \
    +app.port 28082 \
    +server.hostname "Test World" +server.description "" \
    +server.maxplayers 20 +server.level "Procedural Map" \
    +server.worldsize 3000 +server.seed 16909061 +server.saveinterval 300
